narrative: Walking south past Curtain Close on the way home to dinner, he pauses by the outer gatepost where a damp black-letter bill announces a Masters of Defence prize. Title only, no author. No face. He steps past the post without turning into the lane.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the bill on the gatepost and did not turn into the lane.

entities.name: the Curtain
entities.context: Shown on bill in A fencers' bill on the Curtain post
